assets.players/source/turnaround.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel sprite turnaround for a Korean dark fairy-tale apprentice-wizard game. Use FIRST attachment for its broad staircase silhouettes, limited flat color and pixel scale; use SECOND attachment for the established costume identity, headings and positions. Render a carefully crafted middle: native 64×64 game sprite feeling with outlines one logical pixel wide, three controlled value steps per material, only a few purposeful small highlight groups (burnished kettle rim, hat hem, book page block, large cape fold, eye lights), no digital paint, dithering, mottled or grainy texture, no smooth glow. More folded and modeled than basic 16-bit avatars with flat geometric bodies. Camera sees slightly from above: three-quarter FRONT DOWN facing top row, RIGHT profile middle row, BACK UP bottom row. Exactly 5 columns by 3 rows, equal fixed grid centered, no labels, no frames. 15 distinct isolated sprites against real clear transparency. At least 16% free whitespace at every cell edge. NO STAVES. Col1 short copper kettle helmet girl, right spout, teal bob and skirt, chestnut work apron and chalk boots. Col2 slim sleepy boy in indigo long floppy nightcap with hanging tiny lemon-glass lamp, ochre mustard robe with mint trim, slippers. Col3 shorter child with wide brown OPEN BOOK like a peaked roof (distinct visible cream block of pages, teal ribbon), slate robe and belt scroll case. Col4 lavender-white hair and five little crisp detached pale ice shards, calm closed eyes, pale cream cape with sky-blue lining, deep blue dress and leather shoes. NO AURA. Col5 maintain reference's curled brimless plum hood, two small lavender square eyes only, dark slate-blue shoulder cape with diagonal long hem, angular fold planes and small brass clasp, mauve boots. Keep expressive chibi proportions but not bubble heads. Empty hands naturally at waist ready to attach separate staff. Consistent ground anchors and directions. Crisp outlines, color belongs to costume. Avoid noise and tiny overrendered clusters. Transparent exterior including spaces around detached ice crystals. No shadows, no text.
